curb_check.game_likeness: YES — randomized object inspection, rule cross-referencing, mistake pressure, and persistent sorting outcomes retain mastery without the career skin.

pit_crane.game_likeness: YES — spatial mixing and feeding choices visibly alter a grid and temperature system over multiple turns.

gas_watch.game_likeness: YES — limited-probe deduction, suspect elimination, and a one-shot commitment form a reusable mystery loop.

landfill_ops.game_likeness: YES — spatial packing, typed placement, scarce protection, weather, and compounding meters retain management-game mastery.

baby_care.game_likeness: YES — noisy time-series classification has learnable pattern-recognition mastery, though the implemented consequences are weakly gamified.

zoo_checkup.game_likeness: YES — cost-weighted information gathering and committing to a diagnosis remain a deduction game without the animal-care skin.

feed_prep.game_likeness: YES — assembling several orders from conditional specifications and shared inventory retains puzzle mastery.

debut_plan.game_likeness: YES — planning under uncertainty, responding to events, matching mitigation levers, and timing withdrawal form a replayable risk-management loop.

recommended_actions: Make baby_care decisions produce visible, correctness-sensitive world effects: distinctly style correct and wrong calls, show care-state or intervention-state changes, and preserve them through failure.
Add observable animal responses to zoo_checkup tests and treatment outcomes, and retain those world changes on terminal screens.
Replace debut_plan's immediate exact refusal explanations with a visual refusal or generic first nudge; disclose the exact gating method only after staged repetition or run termination.
Keep debut_plan's yard, cub position, crowd, sign lamps, and mitigation state visible on failure.
Drive gas_watch's alert meter from simulated cause progression and intervention effects rather than screen status alone.
